current_training_imagery.source: NAIP via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC; exact IDs reconstructed from retained AOI bbox and latest-year fetcher rule
current_training_imagery.identity_limit: The four reconstructed 2021 NAIP STAC item assets each have eo:bands Red, Green, Blue, NIR. Local mosaic Rasterio colorinterp says red,green,blue,alpha; band role is verified by item metadata but local tag and mask semantics need validation.
current_training_imagery.band_integrity_issue: Exact 2021 STAC eo:bands verify fourth band as NIR for all four reconstructed items. Local TIFF tags label it alpha and nodata=0 triggers NodataShadowWarning. Training reads the four values directly, but mask/valid-coverage audits must be reconciled with pixel data and source footprints.

independent_local_reference_candidates.name: Mountain Trails Foundation Park City trail guide/map
independent_local_reference_candidates.reason: Park City identifies this as its most accurate online local-trail resource, but a dated downloadable GIS/as-built/maintenance layer, lineage, positional uncertainty, historic fit, and ML permission remain unverified. Use as contextual evidence only until those are resolved.

independent_local_reference_candidates.name: Park City Municipal WalkingRoutes ArcGIS FeatureServer layer
independent_local_reference_candidates.known_gaps: The published extent is east of the retained Park City training AOI extent after transforming to WKID 3566. The service exposes no acquisition/lineage date in the reviewed metadata, and this appears to be a walking-route layer rather than a verified MTB singletrack reference. Recheck geographic overlap and layer semantics before using it.

recommended_experiment.design: Lead with exact same 24 replay-canonical windows in current 2021 NAIP and September 2018 NAIP; keep bounded PC2018 municipal comparison as partial-coverage secondary. First resolve input band/mask semantics, validate per-window footprint masks and stable-landmark registration. Have a reviewer blind to labels/predictions score snow, bright bare surfaces, deep shadow, canopy, cloud, and tread visibility separately.
recommended_experiment.registration: Retrieval used matching 127.8 m footprints and the same canonical centerpoints; this is not proof of pixel registration. Estimate offsets on stable landmarks using only valid pixels. Do not compare pixels or use older imagery to score labels until registration and trail-date compatibility are established.
recommended_experiment.decision_rule: September 2018 NAIP is the preferred candidate for blinded visibility review because 24/24 fetched windows return imagery; it is not training-approved. Require within-one-pixel landmark registration, independent reference evidence and 2018 trail-date compatibility, consistent masks, and documented reuse rights before paired label scores or training changes. Preserve snow/shadow/canopy cases as separate unsupported/unknown slices.
not_done: No A VAL modality ablation or training

next_sites.data_quality_limit: NAIP dates and TNM 3DEP metadata extents are discovery evidence; actual valid pixels, weather/season appearance, independent target/distractor sample counts, and site-specific permissions remain unknown.

secondary_municipal_imagery_candidate.source: Microsoft Planetary Computer NAIP 2018; four-item September mosaic
secondary_municipal_imagery_candidate.band_metadata: Exact items eo:bands Red, Green, Blue, NIR; source CRS EPSG:26912, reprojected to EPSG:32612 for same-window display.
secondary_municipal_imagery_candidate.review_status: blinded human scoring, stable-landmark registration, snow/shadow/cloud/canopy/tread visibility and 2018 trail-change compatibility pending
secondary_municipal_imagery_candidate.why_test_it: All 24 canonical windows have nonzero RGB/full reported mask. Image-only panels show many 2021 bright/blue-white windows while September 2018 scenes appear snow-free and clearer. This is a visibility candidate only, not evidence that visible lines are trails or labels are wrong.
secondary_municipal_imagery_candidate.trail_change_risk: 2018 is three years before the current 2021 mosaic; construction, closure and reroute histories must be checked against the independent reference before any trail scoring.
secondary_municipal_imagery_candidate.permission_status: STAC item license unknown; review NAIP/Planetary Computer terms for intended use before any training reuse.
